title: Layer-aware accuracy sentinel and drift-triggered recalibration harness
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an automated accuracy validation harness that evaluates FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles end-to-end using stratified golden prompt sets, layer-wise sensitivity checks, and a configurable pass/fail gate. The harness will be used during model onboarding and periodic regression checks to drive automated recalibration canaries and, if needed, hold rollouts. It must integrate with the existing telemetry pipeline and Redwood Console dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Harness runs nightly across nominated model variants and quant profiles and writes a structured result to the eval store. 2) Defined pass/fail gates evaluate per-metric thresholds (semantic similarity, log-likelihood drift, and output token divergence) and produce a composite verdict. 3) When gate fails for a profile, the system triggers a canary rollback plan and opens a remediation ticket. 4) Results are visible in the Console per-model and include per-layer sensitivity heatmaps. 5) Tests include adversarial prompt perturbations and seed variability checks.
design_notes: Use stratified golden prompt bank: split by prompt length, task type (completion, summarization, Q&A), and domain (support, product, finance).

Measure multiple signals: embedding cosine (anchor vs output), negative log-likelihood delta normalized by token length, edit-distance token delta, and human-like calibration score from small trained binary judge model.

Layer-aware mode: replay activations at export time to estimate per-layer amplification of quantization noise and compute a sensitivity score per layer that helps recommend hybrid-precision or per-layer scaling.
Calibration workflow will be two-stage: quick per-channel scale search (fast, low-cost) then targeted fine-grain retraining/adjustment for flagged layers (longer-running).
Gating strategy: soft gates (warnings) for small deltas, hard gates (block rollout) when composite score exceeds threshold and customer-impact flagged high.
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Implement harness scaffolding and golden prompt loader, add metric collectors (embeddings, NLL, token-diff). Phase 2: Integrate layer-sensitivity profiler into quant pipeline and generate heatmaps. Phase 3: Wire gates into CI and Console alerts; implement canary rollback playbook. Phase 4: Add adversarial perturbation suite and seed variance sweeps. Coordinate with infra to schedule nightly runs on Dedicated capacity pools.
qa_plan: Unit tests for metric computations, synthetic replay with known deltas for regression tests, end-to-end smoke runs on a toy model to validate gating logic, A/B canary to validate rollback behavior in staging. QA checklist will include stability under high request concurrency and floating-point nondeterminism checks.
metrics_and_gates:
- EmbeddingSim: cosine similarity between golden reference embedding and candidate output embedding; pass if >= 0.935 for critical prompts, warning if 0.92-0.935, fail if < 0.92.
- NLLDelta: normalized negative log-likelihood change vs FP32 baseline; pass if < 0.02, warning 0.02-0.05, fail >= 0.05.
- TokenDivergence: normalized Levenshtein token-distance; pass if <= 0.04, warning 0.04-0.08, fail > 0.08.
- LayerSensitivity: top-3 layers contributing > 60% of cumulative sensitivity triggers targeted calibration.
Composite verdict: weighted sum (EmbeddingSim 50%, NLLDelta 30%, TokenDivergence 20%) mapped to pass/warn/fail thresholds.
run_schedule_and_telemetry: Nightly full-suite runs with incremental quick-checks on PRs. Telemetry events emitted: harness.run.start, metric.<name>.value, harness.run.verdict, harness.run.heatmap_url. Exported artifacts stored in s3://redwood-evals/quant-harness/<model>/<run-timestamp>/.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: false positives from embedding judge on paraphrases. Mitigation: include paraphrase-augmented golden set and use dual-signal gating (embedding + NLL). Risk: compute cost for full heatmap on large models. Mitigation: sample-based heatmap estimation and run full heatmap only on failed quick checks.
